## Review acceptance history

- Initial architectural lens: rejected with AR1173-R01-01 through AR1173-R01-07.
- Author continuation r02 corrected the design: explicit single-variable millisecond contract, migration/operator-adoption scope, deterministic timeout/page-loss behavior, fixed delay instead of jitter, and AC-aligned evidence.
- Mechanical guards then exposed missing producer-emission mappings; author continuation r03 added the AC1–AC13 mappings.
- Author continuation r03 added explicit dispositions for all seven findings; each is addressed in the live Issue body.
- Current guard result: positive-outcome PASS; parked-root PASS; contract-evidence PASS; smoke-test-plan PASS. Tier remains T1.
- Collision recorded: open PR #1180 touches `scripts/chatgpt-browser-turn/state-light-turn.ts`, `state-light-turn.test-fixtures.ts`, and `README.md`; implementation ordering must account for that overlap.
- Transport incident recorded: round-02 helper stalled at poll 500 with `completion_ready=true` and empty reply metadata; the architect performed a read-only rescue harvest. No resend or duplicate chat occurred.

Next required stage: fresh terminal architectural review, followed by final acceptance if the terminal source is clean or its findings are dispositioned.

Cycle complete except final acceptance. Final acceptance is blocked by Issue #1186, which owns the canonical comment-census defect. The seven AR1173-R01-01 through AR1173-R01-07 dispositions are already published in the preceding acceptance-history comment; no further review stage will start until #1186 lands.
